title: The same choice after all that delay
odia: ସେଇ ଘଇତା କଲୁ, ବୟସ ଗଡ଼େଇ ଦେଲୁ!
literal_meaning: You married that same husband, after letting the years pass!
explanation: After prolonged delay, the eventual choice is the one available before. The jibe targets the wasted interval.
meaning_odia: ଅନେକ ବେଳ ନେଇ ବିଚାର କରିବା ପରେ ବି ପୂର୍ବର ସେହି ପସନ୍ଦରେ ପହଞ୍ଚିବାରେ ବ୍ୟଙ୍ଗ ଅଛି। ବିଳମ୍ବ ହେଲା, ହେଲେ ଫଳ ବଦଳିଲା ନାହିଁ—ଏହି ଅମେଳକୁ କଥାଟି ଧରେ। ବିବାହର ଉପମା ଥିଲେ ବି ଏହାକୁ କାହାକୁ ତରବରରେ ବିବାହ କରିବାର ଚାପ ଭାବେ ନେବା ଉଚିତ ନୁହେଁ।
usage_example: After months of indecision, a club adopts the venue it first considered. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: Marriage supplies the wording. It need not be used to pressure anyone into marrying early.

odia_summary: ବହୁଦିନ ଗଡ଼ାଇ ଶେଷରେ ସେହି ନିଷ୍ପତ୍ତି ନେଲେ; ଏତେ ବିଳମ୍ବ କରି କଣ ଲାଭ ହେଲା?
english_summary: After a long delay, the eventual choice is the same one that could have been made earlier.
